items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was thinking about, we mentioned Irwin, did the students have any parties? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, if they did, I was a married graduate student, and I don't remember ever going to a party

ctx.x: I'm, you know, I wasn't aware of that, and I guess it always, it would surprise me that there would be a band like the George Williams band. I had been going parades for a year, year and a half, and had never heard of it, and all of a sudden, there it is, you know, and it's got a drum, and it's got George Williams painted on it, and everything, and so, you know, that, that doesn't mean a whole lot, I guess. But, I remember like Barry Ratton, a couple of weeks ago, had a big banner up, it's embroidered, and it…
I was thinking about, we mentioned Irwin, did the students have any parties?
Well, if they did, I was a married graduate student, and I don't remember ever going to a party, You didn't go to a party with a band? Where there was live music, no, no.
